name: Dice Throne Season One ReRolled

categories.label: Won (last hero standing)
categories.hint: Mark the player who was not reduced to 0 Health

winCondition: Reduce opponents' Health to 0; a player at 0 Health is defeated and the last player standing wins. If all remaining players reach 0 Health simultaneously the game is a draw. 2v2: teams share one Health Dial and the team that survives wins. 3 players use King of the Hill (bonus card for attacking the Leader).

endCondition.description: Game ends when only one player (or team) has Health above 0.

notes: family: elimination. No points. Starting Health value is printed as an icon in the rulebook PDF and was not readable, so it is not recorded here. Rulebook v2.4.3 covers the Season One ReRolled heroes (Pirate, Barbarian shown in examples).

sources.title: Dice Throne Rulebook v2.4.3 (2025), linked from Dice Throne FAQ/Downloads
sources.section: Goal; Health Dial and defeat; 2v2 Team Game; King of the Hill
